1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, de hojas ovaladas, oblongas o elípticas y flores amarillentas o blanco verdosas. (Araliaceae; Dendropanax laurifolius).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 20 m, with oval, oblong or elliptical leaves and yellowish-green or greenish-white flowers. (Araliaceae; Dendropanax laurifolius).
